title: 8.2-kiloyear cold event
summary: Global temperatures drop rapidly for two to four centuries, probably after meltwater from draining glacial lakes disrupted North Atlantic currents.
why: Coincides with a Mesolithic population drop in western Scotland and drought in East Africa.

notes.problem: Cause stated as fact; source: 'may have been caused by a large meltwater pulse'; event was a 'drop in global temperatures', and source warns such links are 'difficult'.
